title.narrative: Somalia productive, resilient, and inclusive growth (SPRING) project

description.narrative: Promote private sector-led growth and job creation by improving the business-enabling environment, strengthening the financial system, and enhancing access to finance

The project will continue strengthening foundational building blocks critical for private sector-led growth and is organized under four reinforcing components. The project design will leverage Performance-based Conditions (PBCs) to further incentivize reforms and results as appropriate and follows the Bank Guidance on Financial Intermediary Financing (FIF). Components are:Component 1: Improving the enabling environment for the private sectorSubcomponent 1.1. Strengthening institutional and regulatory framework for the private sectorSubcomponent 1.2. Enhancing the Somali ID SystemComponent 2: Deepening financial sector reforms and strengthening institutional capacitySubcomponent 2.1. Operational and capacity building support to GargaaraSubcomponent 2.2. Strengthening financial sector stability, integrity, and infrastructureComponent 3: Enhancing access to finance and resilience for MSMEs Subcomponent 3.1. Derisking access to finance for MSMEsSubcomponent 3.2. Enhancing MSMEs' resilienceComponent 4: Project ManagementFor the purposes of this project, private sector-led growth means economic growth that is primarily driven by the private sector and job creation means the broad generation of new employment opportunities (including better jobs) linked to specific interventions under this project. Improving the business-enabling environment is understood as positively changing the laws, policies, regulations, systems, and services that facilitate the conduct of private and financial sector activity in the country. Strengthening the financial system means adopting new reforms and supporting the development of institutions for the financial sector, and enhancing access to finance is understood as creating means for select businesses/priority segments to benefit from loans through credit enhancements.
